description: A simple, charming exterior back patio doorway photographed at early dusk. The house facade is smooth white stucco rendered clean and flat, with a slim reveal where the wall meets the white painted wood deck planks. A tall narrow black aluminum-framed sliding glass door or French-style back door occupies the right side of the frame, its glass revealing a warm amber-lit dining space beyond with a wooden round table, dining chairs, and horizontal white venetian blinds. The white timber deck boards are clean-painted and run horizontally at the base. Two potted plants flank the door: on the left, a weathered grey concrete planter holds a loose trailing white-flowered plant with green foliage; on the right, a natural wicker basket pot holds an abundant lavender plant in full purple bloom. Green lawn and dark garden foliage occupy the left background, with a silhouetted tree canopy above. Warm amber light washes down and outward from the wall to the left of the door, illuminating the white stucco surface in a broad arc of golden warmth and casting a soft reflection on the deck below. The sky is a soft dusky blue. The atmosphere is quietly domestic and garden-cottage in mood. Camera is at standing eye-level, three-quarter view capturing the door, both flanking plants, and the wall section to the left where the warm glow is visible.
